qs.s: Les météorologues ont observé une ___ importante des températures cette semaine.

qs.en: The blue dress and the green dress are two variants of the same basic model.

qs.en: The pianist performed a variation by Chopin with remarkable technique.

qs.en: Each variation of this sonata explores a different aspect of the main theme.

qs.en: Employees are more productive when they work in a quiet environment.

qs.en: The brainstorming session was very productive: many ideas emerged.

qs.en: After the training, the (female) workers became much more productive at the factory.

qs.en: These intensive workdays were among the most productive of the year.

qs.en: The teacher organized the grouping of students into small teams for the project.

qs.en: This industrial group owns factories in about ten countries.
